title: Google launches its ‘universal’ online shopping cart ahead of the holidays
hook_text: Google just built your shopping cart.
hook_before: Google just launched its universal online shopping cart.
script:
Zero clicks. That is how Google is changing shopping.
This AI tool is now rolling out across the Gemini app and Google Search in the US.
It aims to simplify the holiday shopping experience for users.
The company first previewed this feature at its I/O event in May.
It tracks products across retailers to prepare you for Black Friday.
Most shoppers will see it pop up in their search results today.
Would you let an AI manage your holiday budget?
